scope: CONTROL gates only; no ExecC1Build candidate scored
detector: frozen c1-count.py, 30 records, exact truth plus mismatch-finding set, gate rc 1 and DRIFT required

ignore-both.mutation: Exact adjacent long-span substring; no boundary filtering; raw occurrence line binding
ignore-both.expected_detector: long-glued-left and long-glued-right both fail; 26/30 [INFERENCE before scoring]

left-only.mutation: Exact adjacent long-span substring; tok_left_ok only; raw occurrence line binding

right-only.mutation: Exact adjacent long-span substring; tok_right_ok only; raw occurrence line binding

restoration_plan: After both mutated-seed runs, replace each scratch control with exact pristine bytes; record SHA256; run frozen detector on restored bytes using first seed. Archived mutant copies remain evidence, not restored production files.
mutation_verdict_rule: A pristine detector failure makes killed/survived attribution inconclusive; still report each negative control's MEETS-TARGET or MISSES against frozen 30/30 target.
